وَحْوَحٌ A strong man, (L, K,) who breathes hard at his work by reason of his briskness and vigour; (L;) as also ↓ وَحْوَاحٌ . (K.) ―
-b2- Also the former, (L, K,) and the latter, (L,) A quick, or prompt, and sharp-spirited, man. (L, K.) ―
-b3- Also the former, (S, K,) and the latter, (S,) A light, or an active, or agile, man. (As, S, K.) ―
-b4- Also both words, A lord, or chief: pl. وَحَاوِحُ and وَحَاوِحَةٌ. (L.) ―
-b5- Also both words, A barking, or howling, dog. (L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
